newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Concorde Travel acquires Cullinan Hotel.
newsitem.headline: Concorde Travel acquires Cullinan Hotel.

text.p: Travel services provider Concorde Travel Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it had acquired the Cullinan Hotel from Airbay Investments in a 85 million rand deal.
The group said the acquisition and the change of control would have the effect of changing the nature of Concorde's main business.
In order to reflect this, it intended to change the company's name to Cullinan Hotel and Leisure Group Limited.
The company would continue to be listed in the "Industrial- Beverages, Hotels and leisure" sector of the Johannesburg Stock Exchange under the abbreviated name "CulTel".
